findings.reason: The protected implementation is a concise, recognizable lower-bound solution at expert-interview quality. first names the first possible target position and majority_offset names the only subsequent index that matters. The standard-library binary search is conventional, the guarded return is immediately readable, and there is no unnecessary state, abstraction, second search, or prohibited generic index binding; no material improvement warrants candidate.py.

bisect_left returns the first position whose value is at least target. If target exists, sorted contiguity makes that its first occurrence. A strict majority requires at least floor(n/2) + 1 copies, so the target block is long enough exactly when first + n // 2 remains in bounds and contains target. An absent target, an exactly-half block, and a shorter block all fail the same guarded equality without an unsafe access.
